name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-07-10, at wavelengths from 0.99 to 4.53 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
